_comment: Single source of truth for ordinal monotone axes per gem family. Consumed by: (1) starsgem-mrpe-v2.py build_monotone_vector() at training time, (2) starsgem-ml-predict.mjs predictMonotoneGeneralized() at inference time. Adding a new gem family = add one entry here; no other monotonicity code changes.

_schema.feature: name of the derived numeric feature in the ML model (e.g. Clarity_Rank)
_schema.rowField: key in the buildStarsgemRow / row dict to sweep when building a ladder (e.g. Clarity)
_schema.order: ordered list of raw values from best-to-highest-rank; JS inference sweeps this array
_schema.direction: +1 = price non-decreasing as rank index increases (Carat, Intensity); -1 = non-increasing (Clarity_Rank rank 0=IF=best)

white_diamond.note: rank 0=IF=best; price is non-increasing as rank increases (PAV non-increasing)
rank 0=D=best; price is non-increasing as rank increases
continuous — constraint only; no ladder sweep needed
log(Carat) — monotone +1; S23 uses this instead of raw Carat in the LightGBM constraint vector so both the raw and log transforms are constrained
grade-agnostic anchor rate per carat — higher anchor implies higher final price; S23 monotone +1 constraint

fancy_color_diamond.note: rank 0=Faint=lowest; price non-decreasing toward Vivid. Deep/Dark are NOT on this ladder — see modifierPenaltyRank.
rank 0=pure hue=no penalty; higher rank=heavier modifier=lower price. Treat as a discount multiplier, not a primary axis.

_future_colored_gemstone._comment: Template for a future sapphire / ruby / emerald model. Uncomment and fill in when training begins.
